decisions.reason: The hand-knotted wool silk carpet remains a good fit with the firm's premium craftsmanship and materials positioning, and having stayed in the range through 2024 suggests enough strategic value to keep it longer despite its niche appeal.

This low-pile decorative carpet still fits the established accessories and interior-concept offer, and the earlier withdrawal of Product A reduces some overlap pressure even though the rug assortment remains somewhat crowded.
The corner bench extends the core furniture portfolio naturally for residential, hospitality and project business, so management would usually continue it rather than free resources from it now.

The low-pile carpet suits the broad furnishing range, but it still faces the highest rationalization risk among the remaining products because several nearby carpet propositions compete for similar space in the collection.
The swivel shell chair line matches the firm's direction toward flexible living and workplace environments and, as a multi-model line, is likely to stay as a useful platform product.
